linux-gfx90a.blocked_reason: CUTLASS-heavy codebase requires Composable Kernel (CK) reimplementation of all GEMM and attention kernels for meaningful AMD support. This is substantial new development (~months of kernel engineering), not a mechanical HIP port. The exec/ backend abstraction is porting-ready, but the core kernel library (139 .cu files) is architecture-locked to NVIDIA (CUTLASS 4.4.2, SM100/110/120 TMA, Flash Attention 2 vendor source). See plan.md for full analysis.

not_portable.reason: CUTLASS-heavy throughout; meaningful AMD support requires reimplementing every GEMM and attention kernel on Composable Kernel, which is new work rather than a port.
